commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-mpc-r4-pilot.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --single-branch --branch research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
test "$(git -C "$WORK/source" rev-parse HEAD)" = 1feaa6af3d2657faa3a3cbb54ee7cfcc24cc6d2a
cd "$WORK/source"
echo MPC_TEST_SOURCE_SHA|$(git rev-parse HEAD)
python3 -m compileall -q tools/ml/mpc
python3 -m unittest -q tests.test_mpc_devices tests.test_mpc_optimizer_mock tests.test_mpc_physics_integration
echo MPC_R4_UNIT_INTEGRATION|TESTS_PASS
set +e
python3 -m tools.ml.mpc.cli --hours 0.05 --step-s 30 --seed 1729 --output-dir "$WORK/mpc" > "$WORK/cli.stdout" 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
cat "$WORK/cli.stdout"
echo MPC_PILOT_EXIT_CODE|$RC
if test "$RC" -ne 0 -a "$RC" -ne 2; then echo MPC_PILOT_TOOL_ERROR; exit 73; fi
python3 - "$WORK/mpc/manifest.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
m=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert m["source_commit"]=="1feaa6af3d2657faa3a3cbb54ee7cfcc24cc6d2a"
assert m["synthetic_uncalibrated"] and not m["physical_validation_with_real_data"]
for p,r in m["baselines"].items():
 print("MPC_PILOT_METRIC|"+json.dumps({"policy":p,**r},separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True))
print("MPC_PILOT_REPRODUCIBLE_MANIFEST|PASS")
PY
